name: The Soul Jam Revue
aliases: The Soul Jam Revue: A Tribute to Philly Soul

evidence.note: Band site: high-energy soul, funk and R&B show that makes you want to dance and sing along.
CM Performing Arts Center page: Philly soul tribute, Sunday Oct 4 at 7 pm.

dancing.notes: The band plays upbeat soul and funk meant to get people dancing, but the Oct 4 show is a seated theater concert, so expect mostly listening with some dancing.

description: Long Island soul and funk revue paying tribute to the 1970s Sound of Philadelphia (The O'Jays, The Spinners, Teddy Pendergrass) plus Earth, Wind & Fire and Kool & the Gang.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Theater setting this weekend; the band also plays outdoor concerts and festivals where dancing is more likely.

Directory research 2026-10-04: All current links (website, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) re-verified from the band's own site; current description is accurate, so no new description. Phone is published on the band's site as the band's contact line (named contact Joe Costanzo) next to the booking form. Photo 2 is a cut-out promo shot on a transparent background (needs a backdrop color when displayed). The 'Booking Inquiry' form is on the home page; the contact page is used as the booking link.

logo.alt: The Soul Jam Revue logo: gold script lettering on a purple badge with a disco ball, a microphone and the words 'a tribute to philly soul'

evidence.note: Band site: tribute to Philly soul, funk and R&B (Spinners, O'Jays, Stylistics and more); links Facebook, Instagram and YouTube; booking form plus a named contact phone.
Band's own event page: live at CM Performing Arts Center, 931 Montauk Hwy, Oakdale, Sun Oct 4, 2026, 7 PM.
Contact page gives the band Gmail address and a phone number for band contact Joe Costanzo.
